items.question: What hand gesture and mantra ending are prescribed for worship within the mandala?
premises: Worship is to be performed within the mandala.
The back of the hand serves as the instrument of worship.
The ritual act is to conclude with the syllable svadhā.
items.inference: Therefore one should worship in the mandala using the back of the hand and ending with svadhā.
uncertainties: The exact ritual gesture implied by karapṛṣṭha in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: One should worship in the mandala with the back of the hand, ending with svadhā.
